subject: Can we move the group call to another time?
text: I need to move our group call to a different slot because the shared workspace will be unavailable for about an hour, and I do not want everyone to keep waiting for a quiet room. I know this is late notice, so I appreciate your flexibility. My practical concern is that our original time will collide with the equipment setup happening in the same area, which could create distracting noise and make it hard for anyone joining remotely to hear the discussion. I would rather reschedule than run the meeting badly. A new time later this afternoon could work if everyone’s calendars allow, or we can shift to early next week after the setup is complete. If you prefer, I can send a short agenda in advance so the replacement call stays focused and no one has to prepare twice. Please reply with the window that suits you, and I will lock in something reasonable and send the updated link. If direct messaging is easier, tell me privately, and I will summarize the change for the rest of the group without adding another long thread. Thank you for understanding, and let me know if there is a particular topic you want to keep at the front of the conversation. The important thing is to choose a moment when participants can focus, review notes, and decide on next steps rather than rushing between commitments. I am happy to shorten the agenda if that helps protect your time or make the new meeting feel more manageable.
